You are operating a real software-engineering sandbox. Solve the task by inspecting and modifying the repository through the provided tools.

Every response must be a tool call until the task is finished. Do not respond with ordinary assistant text, explanations, or code blocks. Text-only responses do not modify the repository and do not complete the task.

Start by calling list_files with path ".". The repository is under repo/.

After the first listing, call list_files again on narrower directories to
locate the implementation. If the issue concerns a service or feature, inspect
the corresponding source directory before guessing a filename.

Use read_file only on a concrete file shown by list_files. If read_file says
that a path is a directory, call list_files on that directory. If read_file
says that a file does not exist, do not modify that guessed path; inspect its
parent directory instead.

Do not create or modify tests, verifier files, task metadata, or files outside
repo/. Test functions shown in the issue describe expected behaviour; they do
not imply that a same-named file exists at the sandbox root.

Make the smallest correct source-code change that solves the task. Prefer replace_lines when read_file provides clear line numbers. Use start_line and end_line exactly as shown by read_file, and replace only the smallest necessary range. For replace_lines, provide new_lines as a JSON array with exactly one source-code line per item. Do not place escaped newline sequences inside an item. Preserve indentation exactly.

When using edit_file, copy old_str exactly from the latest read_file result and include enough surrounding source text to make the match unique. Do not assume that a modification succeeded without inspecting the tool result.

If edit_file, replace_lines, or write_file fails, inspect the error, read the file again when necessary, revise the arguments, and retry. Do not continue as though the repository changed when a modification tool returned an error.

After a successful modification, call run_tests if visible smoke tests are available. If run_tests reports that this task has no visible smoke tests, continue by carefully reviewing the modified source and relevant repository context. Hidden grading tests are not available to you.

Call submit only after making a genuine repair attempt. The episode is complete only when submit succeeds.

[Bug] failure while sanitiainzg exception stack trace in some cases
In some scenarios, one of the insepected frames in the stack trace does not have a module, resulting in a failure to print the underlying error.

The following looks like it's resolving it:

```diff
++ hydra/_internal/utils.py
@@ -248,6 +248,8 @@
                 while end is not None:
                     frame = end.tb_frame
                     mdl = inspect.getmodule(frame)
+                    if mdl is None:
+                        break
-                     assert mdl is not None
```

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in the sandbox, recursively. Start here to see the repo layout.

path.description: Sandbox-relative directory to list. Use '.' for the first call. After inspecting the result, list narrower directories such as 'repo/moto' or 'repo/tests' to find relevant files. Do not guess a file path when a directory can be inspected first.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file with line numbers. Returns at most 200 lines per call; use start/end to page through longer files.

path.description: Sandbox-relative file to read, normally under repo/.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a whole file, replacing any existing content. Prefer edit_file for small changes.

path.description: Sandbox-relative source file under repo/. Do not modify tests or verifier files.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace one exact snippet in a file. old_str must appear exactly once - include surrounding lines to make it unique.

path.description: Sandbox-relative source file under repo/. Do not modify tests or verifier files.

old_str.description: Exact source text copied from the latest read_file output. Include surrounding lines when needed to make the match unique.

new_str.description: Replacement source text implementing the smallest correct repair.

tools.name: replace_lines
tools.description: Replace an inclusive range of 1-based source lines. Use line numbers from read_file. Replaces at most 12 existing lines per call.

path.description: Sandbox-relative source file under repo/. Do not modify tests or verifier files.

start_line.description: First existing source line to replace, using the 1-based numbers from read_file.

end_line.description: Last existing source line to replace, inclusive.

new_lines.description: Replacement source code, one source line per array item. Copy indentation exactly. Use an empty array to delete the selected lines.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run visible smoke tests when the task provides them. Some SWE-Gym tasks have no agent-visible smoke tests; in that case the tool reports that none are available. Hidden grading tests are never exposed.

tools.name: submit
tools.description: Finish the task. Call this once the fix is in place; the episode ends immediately.
